public final class PlayerEndedShipDTO extends ShipConstructionEventDTO
Represents a data transfer data object that holds information about the players that have finished building their ships * Annotations from the Jackson library are used for JSON serialization and deserialization, * ensuring that only non-null values are included in the JSON output.
